name: Zeydoo
description:
Zeydoo is a CPA network for affiliates and publishers. This connector links your Zeydoo account to Claude: you ask in plain language, and Claude reads your connected offers with the payout rates that apply to you, browses the full offer catalogue with its targeting, checks your balance and pulls your traffic statistics — requests, impressions, conversions and earnings, grouped by day, zone, country, platform or request var — and helps you act on the numbers.

Typical prompts: "What's my Zeydoo balance, and how much did I earn in the last 7 days?" "Which of my zones earned the most this month?" "Where did my conversions come from last month, by country?" "Which offers am I running, and what do they pay for US and IT traffic?" "Find offers in the Zeydoo catalogue that accept Android traffic from Brazil."

Requires a Zeydoo publisher account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zeydoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zeydoo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zeydoo.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zeydoo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zeydoo provides these MCP tools: get_balance, get_me, get_my_offers, get_offers, and get_statistics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zeydoo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zeydoo in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Zeydoo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zeydoo is developed by PropellerAds. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
